---
name: gestionauto-product
description: Inspect Gestion Auto reference behavior and turn verified evidence into bounded requirements.
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, `GESTIONAUTO-ROADMAP.md`, and `GESTIONAUTO-MAP.md` first. Use REA/browser only for authorized, read-only inspection. Never export credentials, tokens, identity documents, or reference customer records. For each route, return role, viewport, observed controls and transitions, validation/error/empty behavior, evidence confidence, unknowns, and proposed acceptance criteria. Separate observation from inference. Update the route map only with sanitized observations; do not claim unobserved parity.
